title: CatervasKit
description: What a role's kit is: the skills it carries and the services it may be connected to, stored as roles/<role_id>/kit.yaml beside role.yaml. catervas-roles loads it and refuses what this schema cannot say, each at its field with a code: kit_role_mismatch, kit_skill_missing, kit_skill_in_role, kit_connector_twice, key_page_missing, label_not_a_tool, package_not_pinned, container_not_builtin, image_not_pinned, allowance_not_external, copy_word_refused, and every refusal the team file gives the same entry. See docs/SPEC.md 6.7 and ADR 0036.

role.description: The role, equal to its folder's name.

skills.description: The kit's skills, each a folder skills/<name>/ with a SKILL.md beside this file. They load on demand (ADR 0034), and a role.yaml skill is not named here.

connectorTag.description: A tool's label (spec 5.6): network, it only reads; external_effect, it changes something outside the sandbox or spends credits and asks the human; denied, never offered. There is no read: that tier is the project's files.

connector.description: One service the role may be connected to. stdio and http take the team file's fields and the setup copy (title, about, why, setup, all required); container is a server Catervas runs in Docker itself (image, module_root and args, all required) and has no copy. The loader refuses a missing or foreign field per transport (kit_field_missing, kit_field_not_allowed), which typify cannot read from a conditional schema.

name.description: The connector's name on an agent, and its tools' mcp__<name>__ prefix.

args.description: stdio: the arguments, a package named at an exact version when the command runs one (package_not_pinned). container: the arguments after the image's entrypoint.

title.description: The service, as the user knows it.

setup.description: What the user does. A service's own label may be quoted here (‘…’, “…” or "…", one line, at most 60 characters) and nowhere else.

key_page.description: Where the key is made. Required when credential_keys is not empty (key_page_missing).

labels.description: A tool to what it does in the user's words. A key that is not a tool is label_not_a_tool.

tools.description: Every tool the pinned server lists, each tagged. A tool with no tag is an error.

allowances.description: A tool tagged external_effect to the calls per sprint a user may pre-approve (allowance_not_external otherwise). Step 05b reads it.

plan_approved.description: Tools the owner's approved marketing plan approves: each tagged external_effect (plan_mark_not_external), none with an allowance (plan_mark_with_allowance), and only on Catervas's own connector, catervas connector <name> (plan_mark_not_catervas), since only Catervas's own server can be trusted to check the plan (ADR 0038, ADR 0042). Not part of the team entry or its hash.

image.description: container only: the image, pinned by digest (image_not_pinned).

module_root.description: container only: where the image keeps its Node modules.

what.description: A plural noun, such as images.
